title: Cookie Policy
body_md:
## What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our site. They help us remember your preferences and understand how you use xlmarket.ee.

## Cookies We Use

| Cookie | Purpose | Duration |
|--------|---------|----------|
| session | Cart and login state | Session |
| _ga | Google Analytics | 13 months |
| cookie_consent | Your consent choice | 12 months |

## Essential Cookies

Essential cookies are required for the site to function (cart, checkout). They cannot be disabled.

## Analytics Cookies

We use Google Analytics to understand site usage. You can opt out below or via [Google's opt-out tool](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout).

## Managing Cookies

You can clear cookies at any time in your browser settings. Disabling non-essential cookies will not affect your ability to shop.

## Contact

Questions? Email info@xlmarket.ee.
